scenario: Reconstructed, not observed: no code in the starter kit (full history) or on GitHub uses these labels. From the label set they belong to a mobile record list (LMR) with a search box, a sort order, a filter panel with a date range, and save/error toasts. This scenario is the ground truth for judging.
